这是一个本地补充意见表单：关闭“填写补充意见”开关会隐藏明细字段，但其中的值「保留内容」会保留；隐藏的明细字段也不会阻止表单通过必填校验。点击按钮只会生成一份可编辑的检查草稿，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="补充意见")
toggle = Switch(bind=$on, label="填写补充意见")
nameField = TextField(bind=$name, label="姓名", required=true, placeholder="请输入姓名")
detailField = TextField(bind=$detail, label="补充明细", required=true, visible=$on, multiline=true)
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查此补充意见表单的可编辑草稿。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
